blocks.text: At first glance, Venezuela may seem to offer, like many other Caribbean tourist centers, the same beaches, the same sand, the same clear waters and the same sun.
The difference, however, is that Venezuela also offers an infrastructure that does not exist in the Caribbean islands.
No island in the Caribbean boasts the shopping and business facilities Venezuela has to offer, nor our country’s air travel connections with the rest of the world.
Venezuela has a more competitive capacity and potentiality than all the islands of the Caribbean.

Tourists are very happy in spending a few days enjoying the sun and the beach, but then they are also interested in getting to know the continent. This is more than a tour of an island, which is what is being offered in the Caribbean.

They now set out to discover haciendas and ranches where a whole family is welcome to milk cows, fish in the rivers, get to see many for the first time in their lives – crocodiles and alligators in their natural environment; or they can see horses and other wild animals roam the plains, flamingoes feeding by a river, and finally just listen to the silence of the plains broken by the sound of hundreds of different animals.
The trend now is for tour operators, particularly from Europe, to offer a package of seven days at the beach and seven days in the jungle or plains.
For the above reasons and for many others not mentioned here, we can say that at last Venezuelan tourism business is taking off and no one will ever be able to stop it. Tourism is here to stay.
Decide whether the following statements are TRUE or FALSE.

items.q: Venezuela has more to offer than the Caribbean Islands.
One breath taking view is the Angel Falls located in Bolivar State.
The writer is not very optimistic about the development of tourism in Venezuela.
Tour operators offer European tourists a 14-day combined plan.

lines: *$126* Based on price per person double occupancy
*Bernal’s Royale Package* — «The Best Kept Secret in the Caribbean»

Paradise really exists… It’s in Margarita, a Caribbean island right off he coast of Venezuela. With beautiful mountains and romantic beaches, quaint fisherman villages where you can watch the locals dive for pearls, and where you’ll find the Margarita Bernal’s Hotel. A luxury resort with 500 rooms with air conditioning and breathtaking ocean view. You’ll also enjoy fine dining at our international restaurant, a cocktail lounge, night life, elegant shops and boutiques, water sports and, above all, the warmth and hospitality of its people.

rows: *Annie Service* offers weekends excursions on yachts, sailboats and aeroplanes to Morrocoy, Los Roques, Gran Sabana, Amazonas and Los Llanos. Lodging, meals and soft drinks included in price.
*Los Llanos, 3 day tour.* Discover exotic flora and fauna, animals in their natural habitat, exciting excursions, boating, horseback riding, typical meals. AC. hotel.
*«Bill Fishing»*. Spend a whole day fishing on a 42 ft. or 31 ft. bluemarlin, whitemarlin, sailfish, tuna, wahoo with a professional crew. English spoken. Everything included.
*Merida Hiking, Climbing,* horseback riding, mountain biking. Personalized friendly American service. All equipment furnished.
*La Gran Sabana, 4 day tour.* Transportation and lodging in touristic camps, all meals, soft drinks, specialized guides.
*Amazon, 4 day tour.* Air transportation, AC. hotel, all meals, land and river transportation guides.

blocks.text: Based on the above ads, write a travel plan for your next vacation. (Maximum: 100 words).

items.q: If you had enough money, where would you like to go?
Which do you prefer, traveling by plane or traveling by ship? Explain your preference.
Do you agree with the writer that tourism is becoming a very good business in Venezuela?
What kind of facilities does Venezuela need badly to attract tourists?
What’s the usual attitude towards foreign tourists in Venezuela?
How can this be improved or changed?

blocks.text: Bill Reynolds, an engineer working for a large company, is talking with his colleague Tony Woods about his plans for the next summer vacation.

items: *Bill:* Do you have any plans for this summer?
*Tony:* Yes, I’ll take some courses at Michigan State University. How about you?
*Bill:* Well, you know, I took a couple of special courses there last year. Now I want to take a trip to South America.
*Tony:* Oh, really? Why don’t you go to Venezuela? There’s a lot to see in that country.
*Tony:* Oh, yes. In 1979 the company sent me to Caracas to explore the market for our products. I used my free time to see the beautiful scenery of the country.
*Bill:* Do you really think that Venezuela would be a good choice for the summer?

*Tony:* Sure. You will enjoy some of the most beautiful beaches in the world. Or if you are the adventure type you can take a tour to Canaima National Park, where it’s possible to join excursions to the impressive Angel Falls, the tallest in the world, and also have a closer look at the gigantic rock formations know as «tepuys».
*Bill:* OK. that sounds interesting. But are there any areas with cool temperatures?

*Tony:* Ah, I see what you want. Then you’ll have to go to the Andean Merida State where you can take a trip to the snow capped mountains, riding in the longest and highest cable car in the world. And you can visit the typical quaint villages. Oh, it’ll be an unforgettable experience, I’m quite sure.
*Bill:* Well, after hearing about those marvelous things, I’ve just made up my mind about my summer vacation. It’s a real shame you can’t go to Venezuela with us, you’d be an excellent guide!
